citations.claim: At first violating step body 1 position/velocity are non-finite (null)
One step before, controlled body is settled at final waypoint with ~0 speed

counterfactual.change: Moved final waypoint x by +1.0 (4.09->5.09) so controlled body never dwells exactly at zero distance; same 2422 steps, no violation.

explanation: Controlled body 1 converges to the final waypoint (4.09,2.12) and dwells there with speed ~5e-14 (step 2421). At step 2422 its state becomes non-finite. Disabling the controller removes the failure, and shifting the final waypoint by 1m also removes it. Likely cause: the waypoint steering law normalizes the to-target vector (or divides by distance/speed) without guarding the zero-distance case, producing 0/0 -> NaN force/velocity that propagates to position.
vision_note: The red body sits almost motionless just above the floor near two blue bodies in steps 2419-2421. At step 2422 the red body disappears entirely while the other bodies, walls and waypoints remain.
